messages.message: Draft a short River Station update before the team standup.
river updates land better for me when the outcome comes first, then the evidence. keep that as my normal pattern here.
Make this particular update easy to scan on a phone.
River Station has a production incident and on-call needs a handoff.
Include the first two recovery checks in this handoff.
For River production incidents going forward, put the immediate recovery commands before the outcome summary; that's the narrow exception.
Do not change any files for this request.
